related_questions.question: What cancers are associated with stress?
related_questions.snippet: Many scholars have performed research on the relationships between stress and cancers such as prostate (8–10), breast (8–12), gastric (13, 14), lung (15, 16), and skin cancer (17, 18), and have found evidence indicating that chronic stress can induce tumorigenesis and promote cancer development (Table 1).
related_questions.title: Chronic Stress Promotes Cancer Development - PMC

text_blocks.snippet: While stress alone doesn't directly cause cancer, it can play a significant role in both its development and progression. Chronic stress can negatively impact the body's immune system, potentially making it harder to fight off cancer cells, and can also influence the tumor microenvironment. Additionally, stress can contribute to unhealthy behaviors like smoking and poor diet, which are known risk factors for cancer.
snippet_highlighted_words: stress alone doesn't directly cause cancer, it can play a significant role in both its development and progression

list.title: Immune System:
list.snippet: Stress can suppress the immune system, potentially making it harder for the body to detect and eliminate cancer cells.

list.title: Tumor Microenvironment:
list.snippet: Stress hormones can influence the environment around a tumor, potentially promoting its growth and spread.

list.title: Behavioral Factors:
list.snippet: Stress can lead to unhealthy habits like smoking, excessive alcohol consumption, and poor diet, which are known cancer risk factors.
Oncogenic Viruses: Stress can reactivate latent oncogenic viruses, which are known to contribute to some cancers.
Metastasis: Studies suggest that stress can contribute to the spread of cancer by influencing the formation of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs).
Cancer Recurrence: Some research indicates that stress may be linked to cancer recurrence.

list.title: Manage Stress:
list.snippet: Practice stress-reducing techniques like exercise, meditation, or spending time in nature.

list.title: Seek Support:
list.snippet: If you are struggling with stress, especially in the context of a cancer diagnosis, consider seeking support from a mental health professional.

list.title: Healthy Lifestyle:
list.snippet: Maintain a healthy diet, exercise regularly, and avoid smoking and excessive alcohol consumption.
